article_types.description: Reports on primary, unpublished studies; also covers confirming/disconfirming studies and non-reproducibility reports.
article_types.structure: Abstract, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion

article_types.description: Synthesis of previous research using clearly defined methods; includes meta-syntheses, meta-analyses, mapping/scoping reviews.
Presents a new or established method, protocol, or technique of significant interest in the field.
Comprehensive, balanced overview of a topic with significant recent development -- a full state-of-the-art treatment, not a mere literature summary.
Succinct, focused summary of a current area of investigation and its recent developments.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 2 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Comprehensive, balanced overview of policy/regulation/guideline topics from academia, societies, regulators, or industry. More space than Policy Briefs to elaborate.
Presents a novel, testable argument, interpretation, or model intended to introduce a new hypothesis or theory.
A viewpoint on a specific area of investigation, discussing current advances and future directions; may include original data plus personal insight.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 2 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Documents local experience delivering a service to meet an identified need -- reflection on a program/practice, in contrast to investigator-driven research.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 5 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Explores the concepts and issues that define a field, examining constituent elements and their connections. Must not include unpublished material.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 10 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Describes a research dataset; the dataset must be deposited in a public repository and fixed/publicly available on publication.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 2 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Short, practical, evidence-based evaluation of a policy issue, with policy options and actionable recommendations -- a decision-making tool.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 5 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Original research and/or preliminary findings presented more succinctly and with fewer details than Original Research; negative/non-reproducibility results encouraged.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 4 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Critical comment on a previous Frontiers publication. Commentary on non-Frontiers articles should be submitted as an Opinion instead.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 1 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Viewpoint on the interpretation of recent findings, method value, or hypothesis strengths/weaknesses. Must not contain unpublished/original data; must be evidence-supported, fully referenced, and avoid emotional language.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 1 figures and tables combined.

article_types.description: Presents new technology, code, software, or a novel application of known technology/software, including existing algorithms under novel settings.
